##Loading libraries & First a visualization of population in Greenland 1840-2025
```{r setup, include=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
greenland<-read_csv2("greenland_final.csv")


greenland <- read_delim("greenland_final.csv", delim = ";",
                 locale = locale(decimal_mark = ",", grouping_mark = "."))

head(greenland)

#First a visualization of population in Greenland 1840-2025
ggplot(greenland, aes(x = year, y = population)) +
  geom_line(color = "red", linewidth = 1.0) +
  geom_point(color = "black", size = 1.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Population of Greenland, 1840-2025",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Population"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )
```

##Visualization with data gap-line with a data gap between 1946-1960

```{r echo=TRUE}
#Visualization with data gap-line with a data gap between 1946-1960
ggplot(greenland, aes(x = year, y = population)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1953, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
  annotate("text", x = 1953, y = max(greenland$population, na.rm = TRUE),
           label = "Data gap  1946-60 ", angle = 0, vjust = 2.5, size = 4, color = "grey50") +
  geom_line(color = "red", linewidth = 1.0) +
  geom_point(color = "black", size = 1.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Population of Greenland, 1840-2025",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Population"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  ) 

  scale_y_log10()

```

##Visualization of annual growth in percent 1961-2025

```{r echo=TRUE}
#Visualization of annual growth in percent 1961-2025

library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(plotly)

greenland_growth <- greenland %>%
  filter(year >= 1961) %>%
  arrange(year) %>%
  mutate(growth_pct = (log(population) - log(lag(population))) * 100)

p <- ggplot(greenland_growth, aes(x = year, y = growth_pct)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -1, color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -0.5, color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Population growth (annual %), Greenland 1961-2025",
    subtitle = "Greenland, 1961-2025",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Annual % growth"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(suffix = "%"), breaks = scales::breaks_width(0.5)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )

ggplotly(p)

```
